synopsis: Define and run multi-container applications with Docker.
description: docker-compose allows you to define a multi-container application with all of its dependencies in a single file, then spin the application up in a single command. The application’s structure and configuration are held in a single place, which makes spinning up applications simple and repeatable everywhere.
